title: Historic Music Row Condo-Guitar Shaped Pool
description:
The pool will be open May 1. Recently-renovated, one-bedroom condo close to downtown (Broadway), within walking distance of many attractions and restaurants. Decorated with country music memorabilia, all new furnishings as of June 2017. Comfortable king-size bed and very comfortable state-of-the-art queen sofa bed (No bars, memory foam mattress).

The space
We are located on the fourth floor of the historic Spence Manor  building, which was originally built as a five-star hotel for Elvis to stay when he recorded at the  RCA Studio B.  Other notables who stayed at Spence Manor include The Beatles, Johnny Cash, Willie Nelson, Frank Sinatra and many more. The building has been converted into individually-owned condos.   The location is very convenient to downtown, where country music reigns, Vanderbilt University, Belmont University, and The Gulch. Broadway and its many honky-tonks, is located about a mile away, a $5-6 Uber ride, usually.  Many record labels and publishing companies are located within the block.   We have been in the short-term rental business since the 1990's and pride ourselves on the cleanliness and comfort that our rentals provide for our guests. Fast, secure internet.Free Parking. Washer/dryer. Pack and Play for  little ones. Iron, ironing board, hairdryer and linens provided. The short term rental permit is: T2020033729.  
The kitchen is very well stocked with dishes,cookware, linens.

Guest access
Guests have complete access to the condo, with the exception of a small storage closet in the hallway.

Other things to note
Rates for CMA Fest are $375 per night with a five-night minimum.  Please contact us if you have questions.
The pool is usually open from May until the end of the summer.
Due to individuals' personal preferences, we do not provide soap and shampoo.

Unforeseen circumstances happen so we strongly advise you to purchase trip insurance in case you have flight problems, sickness, or other circumstances!
